title: Pairing link parameters
description: The parameters of a pairing link (PROTOCOL.md §3), as built by `buildUploadLink`: the query string of `pulsecam://?…`, or the fragment of `https://mieweb.github.io/pulse/open#…`. Clients must ignore parameters they don't recognize.

v.description: Link format version. A client refuses a link whose `v` it doesn't know.

artifactId.description: The artifact the pairing is for: the video's id. Related artifacts declare it as `relatedTo`.

server.description: Base URL of the server, including its path prefix (e.g. `https://vault.example.org/pulsevault`). The client builds every request as `${server}/<path>`.

token.description: Optional credential the client sends as `Authorization: Bearer`. Typically a capability token (capability-token.schema.json).

label.description: Optional (protocol 2.7, §3.1): what the client calls the place this upload goes to, e.g. a ticket's title. Unsigned: a display hint. The place's key is the `ref` claim of `token`.

name.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): what the client names a new recording made from this link, e.g. "Huddle update". Absent: the recording starts unnamed. Unsigned.

app.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): the host app's name, shown with `label`. Unsigned.

return.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): a page in the host to go back to after the upload. `https://`, or `http://` to localhost or a private IP for development. Unsigned.
